text:
nina (AE): Starting presales thread for Meridian Labs who want a drop-in replacement for VeridianAPI. Main asks: minimize client changes, ensure prompt/response parity, explain billing differences, and deliver an enterprise security packet.

raj (SE): For an automated shim POC we need: their client SDK request examples (Go/JS/Python), 20 representative prompts (short/long/multi-turn), sample expected outputs or acceptance criteria, and traffic profile (burst qps, sustained qps, percent >4k tokens).

claire (Solutions Eng): I'll own parity checks. Proposed tests: 1) exact-match checks for templated responses, 2) response distribution comparison (KL) for open prompts, 3) schema/strict-json validation to surface parser breakage. Deliverable: 1-page parity summary + 6 concrete diffs. ETA 48–72h after assets.

tom (Infra): We can expose a compatibility endpoint that accepts Veridian payloads and maps fields to Redwood. Need test CIDRs to lock down access and whether they need mutual TLS. If they later want VPC deployment, we'll scope infra in a separate call.

ana (Security): (ana) Send over the vendor questionnaire PDF; I'll pre-fill runtime/infrastructure controls. Key points to highlight: SOC2 status, KMS-integrated encryption-at-rest, TLS everywhere, audit-log retention, SSO (SAML/OIDC), and data deletion controls. Ask Meridian to flag any regulatory constraints (HIPAA, PCI, GDPR).

nina (AE): They mentioned downstream parsers broke due to subtle whitespace/linebreak differences with a previous vendor. Can we provide a strict-json output mode?

claire (Solutions Eng): Yes 9we'll include a strict-json header: X-Redwood-Mode: strict-json. Shim will return {"parsed_output":..., "validation_errors":[]} when enabled. We'll include a small schema enforcement example in the POC artifacts.

raj (SE): Also recommend running a mutated-prompt fuzz test to surface brittle regex parsers (whitespace, punctuation swaps). I can add a tiny harness that mutates inputs and reports parser acceptance rate.

billing-bot: Default POC limits: 60 rps, 200k tokens/day. Request quota bump via billing ops if needed.

nina (AE): Meridian cares about predictable billing. Any quick talking points on per-token billing vs Veridian?

claire (Solutions Eng): Redwood bills primarily on output tokens (with optional compute/embedding units for specific features). We can run their sample workload to produce a side-by-side cost estimate and recommend batching/quantization to reduce unit cost ~20–40% depending on workload. Offer Redwood Optimize as an add-on to tune batching/cache.

tom (Infra): If they send many long-context requests (>8k tokens) we'll recommend either a larger model slice or a quantized variant to keep p95 latency under their SLA. We'll include a cost/latency table for short vs long contexts in the handoff.

ana (Security): I'll attach a 1-page security summary to the POC bundle: SSO options, KMS integrations, retention/deletion options, SOC2 status, and recommended deployment diagrams for Hosted vs Private.

nina (AE): Timeline: they want a demo + parity summary in 5 business days. Feasible?

raj (SE): If assets come by EOD tomorrow (SDK samples, prompts, expected responses, CIDR) I can deliver a compatibility shim and initial parity smoke tests within 4 business days. Need @tom to provision POC key and route.

billing-bot: Action created: quote-request-1745555555 assigned to billing ops.

tom (Infra): I'll provision the POC key and a staging route once I have CIDR. Quick curl for QA: ```bash
curl -X POST https://poc.redwood.local/compat/veridian/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"client_id":"abc123","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize quarterly progress"}],"max_tokens":150}'
```Response will include mapped fields: status, output_text, usage.tokens.

claire (Solutions Eng): I'll add the strict-json example and the fuzz harness to the POC repo. Also will prepare a small human-eval set for any sensitive prompts they identify.

nina (AE): Thanks team 9I'll request artifacts now and loop Legal for vendor addendum. Keeping this thread as the canonical presales coordination channel. :white_check_mark:
